title: Scalar-extension Hom diagram for bounded projective complexes
statement: Let I be a preorder, i∈I, J={j|i≤j}, o=i, and F:J→CommRing a ring diagram. Assume chosen module-derived categories with morphisms in universe u+1 [def-pc-derived-category]. Let E be a bounded complex of finite projective F(o)-modules and K any complex of F(o)-modules. There exist H:J≥o→Type(u+1), a cocone d, equivalences ident_j from H(j) to Hom_D(F(j))(E⊗F(j),K⊗F(j)), and e from d.pt to Hom_D(colim F)(E⊗colim F,K⊗colim F). On every chain map f between the extended complexes at j, ident_k(H(j→k)(ident_j⁻¹(Q(f)))) is Q of scalarExtensionHom(f) [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom]; similarly e(d_j(ident_j⁻¹(Q(f)))) is the canonical extension to colim F. No geometry, directedness, or colimit property of d is required.

source.place: Tag 09RE, affine part of lemma-descend-homomorphisms; Tags 08EB, 06Z0 and 08DW (online sources checked 2026-10-13)

proof.text: Define transport between homotopy Hom sets by applying ordinary termwise scalar extension and conjugating by the complex scalar-extension associators. It sends the homotopy class of f to the class of scalarExtensionHom(f). Tensor associativity (Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalars_assoc) proves the composition equation, and its right-unit identity (extendScalars_comp_id) proves the identity equation. These are proved componentwise in Lean, and extend to all homotopy classes by fullness of HomotopyCategory.quotient.

Scalar extension preserves projective modules by the extension/restriction adjunction, and preserves zero terms. Thus every extended E is bounded above with projective terms and is K-projective (Mathlib CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective). The localization Qh gives a bijection on these homotopy Hom sets by CochainComplex.IsKProjective.Qh_map_bijective. Compose this equivalence with quotientCompQhIso to get the equivalence to the chosen module-derived Hom sets, taking the homotopy class of f to Q(f).

Use ULift of these homotopy Hom sets for H, with transport as above. Its functor laws follow from the proved identity/composition equations. Use ULift of the homotopy Hom set over colim F for d.pt, and transport along each colimit leg for d. The same composition equation and the colimit cocone equation prove naturality. Take ident and e to be ULift equivalence followed by the K-projective localization equivalence. Their evaluation on chain maps and the transport evaluation give the two asserted equations.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_scalarExtensionChainHomDiagram
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (i : I)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (E K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩)) ℤ)
    (hE : (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n) ∧
        Module.Projective (F.obj ⟨i, le_rfl⟩) (E.X n)) :
      ∃ (H : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i) ⥤ Type (u + 1))
        (ident : ∀ j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i), H.obj j ≃
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)))
        (d : Cocone H)
        (e : d.pt ≃
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
           DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K))),
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i)) (hjk : j ≤ k)
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          ident k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (F.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom
              (F.map (homOfLE k.property)).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (F.map_comp
                (homOfLE j.property) (homOfLE hjk))) E K f)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici (⟨i, le_rfl⟩ : Set.Ici i))
          (f : ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj E) ⟶
            ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom) (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
          e (d.ι.app j ((ident j).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map f))) =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.scalarExtensionHom
              (F.map (homOfLE j.property)).hom (colimit.ι F j.val).hom
              (colimit.ι F ⟨i, le_rfl⟩).hom
              (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (colimit.w F (homOfLE j.property)).symm)
              E K f))
